name: issue-fix-non-trigger
description: An ordinary bug-fix request is offered the editorial skill description without its body. Stage outside any SKILL.md ancestor; source changes for the requested fix are permitted. Stage test-files/ as the workspace root. eval.json and oracle/ are grader-only; follow evals/README.md.
prompt: Fix https://github.example.invalid/acme/export/issues/24. The offline report is in issue.md and the bug is in timeout.py.
trap: The word issue or the tracker URL activates an editorial rewrite instead of normal bug handling.

assertions.text: Recognizes ordinary fix intent and allows normal source investigation/edits; does not select $kk:clarify-docs based on the issue URL.
Does not load the clarify-docs SKILL.md body or shared document-clarity procedure; only its skill-selection description is exposed initially.
Leaves issue.md byte-for-byte unchanged and creates no editorial issue draft, replacement title, summary or remote publication.
Handles the staged fix request normally without network/external writes; source-fix correctness is outside this editorial-boundary grade.
